content: Supabase service_role/secret key always bypasses RLS (bypassrls role). A backend that is the only Supabase client and uses service role means RLS is dead code; one missing tenant_id filter leaks cross-tenant data and tests will not catch it because dev data is single-tenant. Pattern: API routes handling user requests should run as the user (forward user JWT, or SET LOCAL role/claims in a transaction) so RLS is defense-in-depth; reserve service role for explicit admin/jobs. Sources: supabase.com RLS docs, makerkit RLS best practices, dev.to multi-tenant RLS.
